cohort: A 23-year-old pregnant woman at 22 weeks gestation
finding: This case report describes a pregnant woman who developed haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, a life-threatening immune activation syndrome, and responded well to treatment with corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin, and anakinra.
gest_age: 22 weeks at presentation, 31 + 5 weeks at delivery
